svg.aria-label: Entity-relationship sheet of the nine tables in a book database on the full schema, with the clock columns on nodes and edges and the timeline table
svg.text: ONE SQLITE FILE PER BOOK · EF CORE · EnsureCreated · THE FULL SCHEMA
CLOCKS on every node and edge:
RULES THAT TRAVEL WITH THE DATA
Offsets: UTF-16 code units of the committed UTF-8 text, CRLF = 2, ranges [start, end). The text's SHA-256 is in every run.json and the provenance file.
Edges: PARTICIPATED_IN Character → Event · DISCOVERED Event → Fact (how) · PERCEIVES Character → Fact | Character (kind; closed, never edited).
Spoilers off: revealed_pos ≤ pos, not retracted. Spoilers on: story_from_lo ≤ story(pos), not ended.
Query side: a node = labels + JSON keys + its clocks; a relationship = type + JSON keys + the clocks in camelCase; visible() applies the rule. Leak tests on every build.
